metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1973 · Fantastic Planet
metas.description: On a faraway planet where blue giants rule, oppressed humanoids rebel against their machine-like leaders.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1979 · Lupin III: The Castle of Cagliostro
metas.description: A dashing thief, his gang of desperadoes and an intrepid cop struggle to free a princess from an evil count, and learn the secret of a treasure that she holds part of the key to.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1973 · Robin Hood
metas.description: The story of the legendary British outlaw portrayed with the characters as anthropomorphic animals.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1978 · Watership Down
metas.description: Hoping to escape destruction by human developers and save their community, a colony of rabbits, led by Hazel and Fiver, seek out a safe place to set up a new warren.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1977 · The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
metas.description: In this collection of animated shorts based on the stories and characters by A.A. Milne, Winnie the Pooh, a honey-loving teddy bear, embarks on some eccentric adventures.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1970 · The Aristocats
metas.description: With the help of a smooth talking tomcat, a family of Parisian felines set to inherit a fortune from their owner try to make it back home after a jealous butler kidnaps them and leaves them in the country.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1971 · Bedknobs and Broomsticks
metas.description: An apprentice witch, three kids, and a cynical magician conman search for the missing component to a magic spell to be used in the defense of Britain in World War II.
